title: Acceptance probability of the sign-AND tester
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The acceptance probability of the tester that samples independent uniform $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$ and checks whether $f(x)\wedge f(y)=f(x\wedge y)$ is $\mathbb{E}_{x,y}\,\mathbf{1}_{\{f(x)\wedge f(y)=f(x\wedge y)\}}$, where $-1\wedge-1=-1$ and the other sign pairs have AND value $1$.
